_comment: Content of the hero banner. Edit the lines, push, and the Banner workflow redraws both themes. 'cmd' lines get the accent prompt, 'hi' is a highlighted answer, 'out' is secondary text.

source._comment: Frames cross-fade in order on their own loop. Add or reorder them freely; grab new icons with `python scripts/fetch_icons.py <slug>`.
source._field_help: Minimum ink in every cell, drawn once as a static backdrop. Gives the panel its lit-matrix look; set 0 to have the icons float on bare background.

dotify._shape_help: Square, to match the panel. Logos are simple shapes, so this resolves them cleanly.
dotify._autocontrast_help: Logos are flat silhouettes - there is no tonal range to stretch, and stretching only amplifies the anti-aliased edge.
